caseName: William Ash Co. v. Reclamation Board
caseNameFull: William Ash Company v. Reclamation Board of the State of California
attorneys: Mr. Stephen W. Downey and Mr. Bradford M. Melvin, for defendants in error, in support of the motion to dismiss or affirm. Mr. J. W. Dorsey and Mr. B. F. M. Soto, for plaintiffs in error, in opposition to the motion.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for the want of jurisdiction upon the authority of Shulthis v. McDougal, 225 U. S. 561, 569; Hull v. Burr, 234 U. S. 712, 720; Norton v. Whiteside, 239 U. S. 144, 147.
